__1 A star; ननु भन्यमूनि [[Rām. Ch. 6. 33]]; भगणो भाति यद्भयात् [[Bhāg. 3. 29. 4.]] 
__2 A lunar mansion or asterism.

__4 A sign of the zodiac. 
__5 The number twenty-seven. 
-Comp. 
-ईनः, -ईशः 
__1 the sun. 
__2 the regent of an asterism. 
-कक्षा the path of the asterisms. 
-गणः, -वर्गः 
__1 the group of stars or asterisms. 
__2 the zodiac. 
__3 revolution of the planets in the zodiac. 
-गमः the revolution of a planet; [[Hch.]] 
-गोलः the starry sphere. 
-चकम्, -पञ्जरः, -मण्डलम् the zodiac. °नाभिः the centre of the zodiac. 
-प a. the regent of an asterism. 
-पतिः the moon. 
-भ्रमः a sidereal day. 
-लता Paederia Foetida (Mar. हरणबेल). 
-वासरः a sidereal day. 
-सन्धिः N. of the last quarters of the asterisms, आश्लेषा, ज्येष्ठा and रेबती. 
-सूचकः an astrologer.
